messages:
mira: FYI — VentureWorks activity dropped ~48% over the past week after we handed off onboarding. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/telemetry/ventureworks (big fall for /chat and /embeddings).

tyler: Saw that. They flipped SSO on 2025-03-10 per the runbook but we never got a final smoke-test from their infra team.

sanjay: AE here. Procurement told me they're sitting through a NorthLight demo next Tue. This looks like a potential renewal risk if we don't show immediate remediation.

anya: I can pull a token- & route-level snapshot + P95/P99 latency. @mira which routes do we consider mission-critical for them?

mira: Mission-critical: `POST /v1/chat` (primary), `POST /v1/embeddings` (bulk), and their custom reranker hitting the dedicated queue.

tyler: Correlation: a small auth-error spike and 502s right after the SSO cutover around 2025-03-11T03:12Z. Attaching relevant log snippets to the shared doc.

elena: Customer note (Elena): "Users saw doubled latency on chat flows and intermittent 401s — a few sessions dropped mid-conversation." Looping me into this thread.

sanjay: Quick playbook I'm proposing:
1) Short-term: enable emergency API-key fallback for a named service account to restore sessions.
2) Medium-term: offer a 14-day dedicated burst pool (we'll show cost/benefit).
3) Schedule an exec-level sync with Elena + procurement this Wed to demonstrate plan and ROI.

anya: I'll model the burst pool cost delta and expected latency improvement (P95/P99) by EOD and export a per-route CSV.

tyler: I can rehearse a hitless rollback in staging and prepare a canary for prod. Need the VentureWorks tech contact to get expedited approvals — @mira pls intro.

mira: Intro sent to Elena (cc'ed). Uploaded a timeline and flagged auth errors in the shared folder.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20250311-VW-AUTH for elevated auth failures and error rates. PagerDuty alerts triggered.

sanjay: Owners: @tyler — rollback rehearsal & canary (owner). @anya — cost + SLA uplift analysis (owner). @mira — customer comms + exec brief scheduling (owner). I'll pull slides for the exec ROI brief.

mira: Cool. If canary rollback looks safe, we'll coordinate a temporary key rollout while engineering investigates SSO root cause.

tyler: Do we have an existing condensed runbook for temporary API-key fallback? If not, I'll draft one and post it here for approval.

anya: I sliced the last 14 days by seat and tagged the users that dropped off. Sharing the CSV via DM to the thread owners.

sanjay: Goal: present mitigations + cost delta Tue morning to preempt NorthLight demo next Tue. :thumbsup:

mira: I'll draft a short customer-facing note to calm procurement and outline immediate mitigations. Will share after the exec brief.
